reviews.name: Hiroshi Tanaka
reviews.text: Quiet, clean, and beautifully designed. The private pool was the highlight — we used it every morning. The staff were attentive without being intrusive, and the location in Kerobokan made it easy to get anywhere in south Bali. Strongly recommend for travelers who want peace.
